title: {p} Chili
steps: Brown the {p} in a heavy pot, breaking it up, then add the {v} and the {spice} and cook 5 minutes.
Add the {sauce} and enough water or stock to cover. Canned beans only need draining; dried kidney beans need soaking, then a hard boil of at least 10 minutes, first.
Simmer 30 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chili thickens and any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
Serve with the {s} and something fresh, like onion, cilantro or lime.
tip: Use more beans and veg than meat, choose lean meat, and keep the cornbread to a small piece.
